scripts.dev: npx concurrently "cd backend && npm run start:dev" "cd ui && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd ui && npm run build && mkdir -p ../backend/public && cp -r dist/* ../backend/public/ && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.test: concurrently "cd backend && npm test" "cd ui && npm run test"
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd backend && npm run lint" "cd ui && npm run lint"
scripts.format: concurrently "cd backend && npm run format" "cd ui && npm run format"
scripts.types:generate: cd backend && npm run openapi:generate && cd ../ui && npm run types:generate
